arguments.argument: mkdir -p target/test-src target/test-src/com/davidvlijmincx/lio/api && cp -r src/test/java/* target/test-src/ && echo 'package com.davidvlijmincx.lio.api; public class NativeBridge { public static int open(String path, int flags, int mode) { return NativeDispatcher.C.open(path, flags, mode); } public static void close(int fd) { NativeDispatcher.C.close(fd); } }' > target/test-src/com/davidvlijmincx/lio/api/NativeBridge.java && sed -i 's/com\.davidvlijmincx\.lio\.api\.NativeDispatcher\.C\./com.davidvlijmincx.lio.api.NativeBridge./g' target/test-src/bench/suite/common/IoHelper.java

import os
precond = r'''#!/usr/bin/env bash # precondition.sh: fio randwrite 4 KiB QD=32 on the target file until time runs out. set -euo pipefail if [[ $# -lt 2 ]]; then echo "Usage: $0 <target_file> <minutes> [results_dir]" >&2; exit 1; fi TARGET_FILE="$1"; MINUTES="$2"; RESULTS_DIR="${3:-results/$(date +%F)}" mkdir -p "$RESULTS_DIR" if [[ ! -f "$TARGET_FILE" ]]; then echo "Error: target file $TARGET_FILE does not exist" >&2; exit 1; fi FIO_BIN="${FIO_BIN:-fio}" if ! command -v "$FIO_BIN" &>/dev/null; then echo "Error: fio ($FIO_BIN) not found in PATH" >&2; exit 1; fi TOTAL_SECS=$(awk -v m="$MINUTES" 'BEGIN {print int(m * 60)}') WIN_SECS=30 if [[ "$TOTAL_SECS" -lt 30 ]]; then WIN_SECS="$TOTAL_SECS"; if [[ "$WIN_SECS" -lt 1 ]]; then WIN_SECS=1; fi; fi NUM_WINDOWS=$(( TOTAL_SECS / WIN_SECS )) if [[ "$NUM_WINDOWS" -lt 1 ]]; then NUM_WINDOWS=1; fi BASE_NAME=$(basename "$TARGET_FILE" .bin) OUT_JSON="$RESULTS_DIR/precondition-${BASE_NAME}.json" WINDOWS_DATA=() START_TIME=$(date +%s) for ((w = 1; w <= NUM_WINDOWS; w++)); do TMP_OUT=$(mktemp --suffix=.json) STATUS=0 "$FIO_BIN" --name=precond --filename="$TARGET_FILE" --ioengine=io_uring --direct=1 --bs=4k --rw=randwrite --iodepth=32 --norandommap --randrepeat=0 --time_based --runtime="${WIN_SECS}s" --output-format=json --output="$TMP_OUT" || STATUS=$? if [[ $STATUS -ne 0 ]]; then echo "Error: fio exited with code $STATUS during window $w" >&2; rm -f "$TMP_OUT"; exit $STATUS; fi IOPS=$(jq -r '.jobs[0].write.iops // 0' "$TMP_OUT" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) rm -f "$TMP_OUT" ELAPSED=$(( $(date +%s) - START_TIME )) echo " [precondition] Window $w/$NUM_WINDOWS (${ELAPSED}s elapsed): $IOPS IOPS" WINDOWS_DATA+=("{\"window\": $w, \"elapsed_s\": $ELAPSED, \"iops\": $IOPS}") done jq -n --arg file "$TARGET_FILE" --argjson minutes "$MINUTES" --argjson total_s "$TOTAL_SECS" --argjson windows "$(printf '%s\n' "${WINDOWS_DATA[@]}" | jq -s .)" '{target_file: $file, target_minutes: $minutes, elapsed_seconds: $total_s, qd: 32, block_size: "4k", windows: $windows}' > "$OUT_JSON" echo "Preconditioning complete. Logged $NUM_WINDOWS windows to $OUT_JSON" ''' with open("bench/precondition.sh", "w") as f: f.write(precond) os.chmod("bench/precondition.sh", 0o755) import shutil shutil.rmtree("bench/__pycache__", ignore_errors=True)
iou = r'''#!/usr/bin/env bash # count_iou_wrk.sh: Samples iou-wrk thread count and total CPU during a process run set -euo pipefail if [[ $# -lt 1 ]]; then echo "Usage: $0 <pid> [out_file]" >&2; exit 1; fi PID="$1"; OUT_FILE="${2:-results/$(date +%F)/iou-wrk-buffered-write.json}" mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT_FILE")" SAMPLES=(); MAX_THREADS=0; SUM_THREADS=0; MAX_CPU=0; N=0 while kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; do LINES=$(ps -L -o tid,comm,%cpu -p "$PID" 2>/dev/null | grep 'iou-wrk' || true) if [[ -n "$LINES" ]]; then CNT=$(echo "$LINES" | grep -c 'iou-wrk' || echo 0) CPU=$(echo "$LINES" | awk '{sum+=$3} END{print sum+0}') else CNT=0; CPU=0.0 fi if [[ $CNT -gt $MAX_THREADS ]]; then MAX_THREADS=$CNT; fi if awk "BEGIN {exit !($CPU > $MAX_CPU)}"; then MAX_CPU=$CPU; fi SUM_THREADS=$(( SUM_THREADS + CNT )) N=$(( N + 1 )) SAMPLES+=("{\"sample\": $N, \"threads\": $CNT, \"cpu_percent\": $CPU}") sleep 0.5 || break done AVG_THREADS=0 if [[ $N -gt 0 ]]; then AVG_THREADS=$(awk -v s="$SUM_THREADS" -v n="$N" 'BEGIN {printf "%.2f", s / n}'); fi jq -n --argjson pid "$PID" --argjson samples_count "$N" --argjson max_threads "$MAX_THREADS" --argjson avg_threads "$AVG_THREADS" --argjson max_cpu "$MAX_CPU" --argjson samples "$(printf '%s\n' "${SAMPLES[@]:-}" | jq -s . 2>/dev/null || echo '[]')" '{target_pid: $pid, sample_count: $samples_count, max_iou_wrk_threads: $max_threads, avg_iou_wrk_threads: $avg_threads, max_cpu_percent: $max_cpu, samples: $samples}' > "$OUT_FILE" echo "iou-wrk sampling complete ($N samples). Max threads: $MAX_THREADS, Max CPU: ${MAX_CPU}%. Logged to $OUT_FILE" ''' with open("bench/count_iou_wrk.sh", "w") as f: f.write(iou) os.chmod("bench/count_iou_wrk.sh", 0o755)
drive = r'''#!/usr/bin/env bash # log_drive_state.sh: Logs NVMe temperature, throttle counters, and filesystem fill level set -euo pipefail if [[ $# -lt 1 ]]; then echo "Usage: $0 <out_file> [data_dir]" >&2; exit 1; fi OUT_FILE="$1"; DATA_DIR="${2:-${JURING_DATA_DIR:-/home/david/testData}}" mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT_FILE")" MNT=$(findmnt -n -o TARGET --target "$DATA_DIR" 2>/dev/null || echo "/mnt/TestData") DEV=$(findmnt -n -o SOURCE --target "$DATA_DIR" 2>/dev/null || echo "/dev/nvme1n1p1") DF_LINE=$(df -h "$MNT" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1 || echo "") FILL_PCT=$(echo "$DF_LINE" | awk '{print $5}' | tr -d '%' || echo "0") USED=$(echo "$DF_LINE" | awk '{print $3}' || echo "unknown") AVAIL=$(echo "$DF_LINE" | awk '{print $4}' || echo "unknown") TEMP_C="unknown"; CRIT_C="unknown"; ALARM="0"; THROTTLE_COUNT="unknown"; THROTTLE_TIME="unknown" NVME_DEV="/dev/$(lsblk -no PKNAME "$DEV" 2>/dev/null || echo "nvme1")" if command -v nvme &>/dev/null; then SMART_OUT=$(nvme smart-log "$NVME_DEV" 2>/dev/null || true) if [[ -n "$SMART_OUT" ]]; then TEMP_C=$(echo "$SMART_OUT" | awk '/^temperature/ {print $3}' | tr -d '[:alpha:]' || echo "unknown") THROTTLE_COUNT=$(echo "$SMART_OUT" | awk '/thm_temp1_trans_count/ {print $3}' || echo "0") THROTTLE_TIME=$(echo "$SMART_OUT" | awk '/thm_temp1_total_time/ {print $3}' || echo "0") fi fi if [[ "$TEMP_C" == "unknown" ]]; then for hwmon in /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*; do if [[ -f "$hwmon/name" && $(cat "$hwmon/name") == "nvme" ]]; then if [[ -f "$hwmon/temp1_input" ]]; then RAW=$(cat "$hwmon/temp1_input") TEMP_C=$(awk -v r="$RAW" 'BEGIN {printf "%.1f", r / 1000.0}') fi if [[ -f "$hwmon/temp1_crit" ]]; then RAW_CRIT=$(cat "$hwmon/temp1_crit") CRIT_C=$(awk -v r="$RAW_CRIT" 'BEGIN {printf "%.1f", r / 1000.0}') fi if [[ -f "$hwmon/temp1_alarm" ]]; then ALARM=$(cat "$hwmon/temp1_alarm") fi break fi done fi jq -n --arg timestamp "$(date -Iseconds)" --arg mnt "$MNT" --arg dev "$DEV" --arg fill "$FILL_PCT" --arg used "$USED" --arg avail "$AVAIL" --arg temp "$TEMP_C" --arg crit "$CRIT_C" --arg alarm "$ALARM" --arg thm_count "$THROTTLE_COUNT" --arg thm_time "$THROTTLE_TIME" '{timestamp: $timestamp, mount_point: $mnt, device: $dev, filesystem_fill_percent: $fill, used_space: $used, available_space: $avail, temperature_c: $temp, temp_crit_c: $crit, temp_alarm: $alarm, thm_temp1_trans_count: $thm_count, thm_temp1_total_time: $thm_time}' > "$OUT_FILE" echo "Logged drive state to $OUT_FILE (Temp: ${TEMP_C}°C, Fill: ${FILL_PCT}%)" ''' with open("bench/log_drive_state.sh", "w") as f: f.write(drive) os.chmod("bench/log_drive_state.sh", 0o755)
